## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Bhāvanāyapahātabbaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.54) is an Abhidhamma text located within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding treatise of the Pali canonical Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. In this section, the analytical matrix of conditional relations (paccaya) is applied to the intersection of the dyad of states to be abandoned by mental development (*bhāvanāya pahātabba duka*) with the triad of wholesome states (*kusalattika*) [SuttaCentral].
No ancient external parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are registered by SuttaCentral, and DharmaNexus identifies no cross-language alignments meeting the score threshold [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali tradition, however, DharmaNexus reports extensive formulaic reuse characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna*, detecting 91 matching passages across 36 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial textual parallels occur within other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, notably *Piṭṭhiduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 21.16, with 9 matches spanning segments §1.1–3.1), *Cūḷantaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 21.5), *Piṭṭhiduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.13), *Rūpīduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.29), and the closely related *Bhāvanāyapahātabbahetukaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.56) [DharmaNexus].
